name: noctcore/jobs
headline: Jobs without the traps.
subline: Every add picks a dedupe. Every retry backs off.
alt: noctcore/jobs. Jobs without the traps. Every add picks a dedupe. Every retry backs off. Diagram: add() passes the producer, the dedupe and the queue policy to a JobHost worker and ends completed; a hung request stops at the producer, a duplicate job at the dedupe and a retry storm at the policy.
description: One add() call on its way to completed: inside add(), the producer guard refuses at once while Redis is down, so a request never hangs, and the required dedupe drops a repeat of the same job; the queue policy's jittered backoff keeps retries from firing as one storm; a JobHost worker runs the job.
